units.function: Render a branded Markdown README and Mermaid Agent reporting chart for exported company packages.
units.dependencyDirection: A presentation helper imports the shared portability manifest and directly embeds product branding, CLI instructions, URLs, role labels, package counts and wall-clock time.
units.keyDataModels: Portable Agents/reporting slugs, projects, skills/source locators and issues summarized into Mermaid, Markdown tables/lists and install instructions.
units.lifecycle: Render Agent nodes and reporting edges; build branded inventory sections; append import command, documentation link and current export date.
units.testAssessment: No dedicated unit exists. Broader portability tests do not cover Mermaid ID collisions, grammar/newline injection, Markdown table/link escaping, credential-bearing source locators, deterministic output, localization or human-responsibility completeness.
units.designRationale: Make a portable package understandable and shareable in GitHub or a local folder without opening Paperclip first.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS should also generate a human-readable package summary, but it must be deterministic, safe, Chinese/English-capable and centered on the complete human-Agent responsibility/data/evidence graph.
units.companyOsFit: REIMPLEMENT as a projection renderer over a signed canonical manifest. Use collision-free opaque Mermaid IDs, context-aware Markdown/Mermaid escaping, allowlisted/redacted links, injected deterministic export time, stable localization keys and explicit sections for accountable humans, departments, responsibility contracts, approvals, data authorizations, evidence and semantic-loss warnings. ADAPT only the idea of a readable summary alongside the machine manifest.
units.responsibilityConflict: The chart models only Agents and reporting relationships, presenting an 'Agent Company' without accountable humans, authority, approvals, data contracts or evidence. This conflicts directly with Company OS's legal/organizational responsibility premise.
evidence: 73eb23734f25c570d88665e672f80d740797c632 docs: use structured agent mentions in paperclip skill (#4103)
no dedicated test unit; existing COMPLETE portability evidence reused without rereading
securityFindings: Distinct slugs can collapse to the same Mermaid node ID after character replacement, merging identities and misrepresenting reporting relationships.
Mermaid escaping omits line breaks and other grammar controls, while most Markdown contexts receive no escaping at all; package-controlled text can rewrite the rendered document structure.
Arbitrary skill sourceLocator values become clickable links and may disclose URL credentials or unsafe/untrusted destinations.
Wall-clock output prevents reproducible package bytes and complicates canonical digest/signature verification.
